decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby approved is completed, a landscaping scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority providing appropriate tree or shrub planting towards the boundary to Abinger Road. The scheme shall be planted in the planting season immediately following the completion of the development and thereafter permanently retained.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing house
